verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents a first-party programmatic surface: it runs non-interactively in scripts and emits structured `json` and `stream-json` output, so the core agent work can be driven without the interactive UI. Nothing shows that every interactive capability is reachable this way, such as the slash commands (/memory, /stats, /tools, /mcp) or checkpoint resume, and no REST/OpenAPI surface was found. Missing for 10: documented parity between interactive and non-interactive modes, programmatic access to slash-command functions and session checkpointing, a formal API reference, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Run non-interactively in scripts for workflow automation
use the `--output-format json` flag to get structured output
use `--output-format stream-json` to get newline-delimited JSON events
